## Changes

* Improved CLI stability and robustness
* Introduced validation capabilities for semantic versions
* Addressed critical bugs in argument handling
* Added new functionality to verify version string validity
* Updated internal regex for parsing version strings
* Exposed static method isvalid in VersionInfo class
* Added check subcommand for validating version strings
* Refactored public API to expose distinct entry points for subcommands
* Updated documentation to reflect new validation features and CLI improvements

arguments.command: git commit -m "Implement isvalid method and refactor public API"
git commit -m "Update API documentation for VersionInfo class"
